name: Inuyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Inuyama city emblem in black: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised horizontal device.
history: Municipal flag of Inuyama, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1954.

features.role: Inuyama city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised horizontal device
